captcha_subtitle: Confirming you are human before continuing.
onboarding_scan_body: Point your camera at a textbook page, a menu, a street sign - anything with text you want to learn from.
onboarding_words_body: LexiSnap picks out the vocabulary worth learning from your scan and lets you choose which ones to keep.
onboarding_sentences_body: Generate an example sentence for any word and add it to the card's details - context makes it stick.
onboarding_deck_body: Flashcards are built automatically, so you can start reviewing right away.
brand_tagline: AI flashcards from anything you scan
signup_subtitle: Sign up with your email to get started
signup_check_inbox_body: Check your inbox to confirm your email before logging in.
forgot_password_subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to reset your password.
forgot_password_check_email_body: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it below to reset your password.
forgot_password_code_resent: We sent you a new code.
validator_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters
validator_code_required: Enter the code from the email
validator_code_invalid: Enter the full code from the email
home_all_caught_up: All caught up - come back tomorrow
home_practice_note: Extra practice - your schedule stays as it is
home_streak_start_hint: Study today to start your streak
home_no_decks_body: Scan something to create your first deck.
decks_mixed_practice: Nothing due - practice a few anyway
profile_about_coming_soon: About page is on the way.
sign_out_confirm_body: Your decks are saved to your account, so they'll be right here when you sign back in.
photo_updated: Your profile photo has been updated.
photo_removed: Your profile photo has been removed.
photo_too_large: That photo is too large, even after shrinking it. Try a different one.
photo_unsupported: That file type isn't supported. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
photo_camera_primer_body: LexiSnap needs your camera to take your profile photo.
photo_camera_denied_body: Camera access is off for LexiSnap. Enable it in Settings to take a profile photo.
password_set_body: You signed in with Google. Add a password to also sign in with your email.
email_change_subtitle: Enter the address you'd like to use. We'll send it a code to confirm it's yours.
email_change_code_new_body: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it below to confirm your new address.
email_change_code_current_body: For your security, we also sent a code to your current address, {email}. Enter it to finish the change.
delete_intro: Deleting your account permanently erases everything in it:
delete_item_decks: All of your decks and flashcards
delete_item_progress: Your streaks, study history and progress
delete_item_profile: Your profile, photo and sign-in details
delete_permanent_note: This can't be undone. Once your account is deleted, your data can't be recovered in any way - not by you, and not by us.
delete_confirm_understand: I understand that my account and all of its data will be permanently deleted and can never be recovered.
delete_final_body: Your account and everything in it will be erased right now. There is no way to get it back.
help_faq_1_a: Use your email and password, or continue with Google.
help_faq_2_q: I forgot my password. What now?
help_faq_2_a: On the login screen, tap 'Forgot password?' and we'll email you a reset link.
help_faq_3_a: Yes. Your account is authenticated through Supabase, and your password is never stored in plain text.
help_faq_4_a: Open the Profile tab and tap 'Sign out' at the bottom.
help_faq_5_q: Can I change my display name?
help_faq_5_a: Yes - go to Profile and tap your name to update it.
help_send_message_body: Send us a message and we'll get back to you by email.
help_message_hint: What do you need help with?
help_empty_message_error: Tell us what you need help with first.
help_no_email_app_error: No email app is set up on this device.
help_message_sent_success: Message sent. We've emailed you a copy.
help_send_error: Couldn't send your message. Please try again.
scan_source_subtitle: Capture a photo or choose one from your gallery to pull out new vocabulary.
scan_select_words_subtitle: Tap the words you want to turn into flashcards.
scan_no_text_found_body: We couldn't find any readable text in that photo. Try a clearer, well-lit shot.
scan_processing_error: Couldn't read that photo. Please try again.
scan_multiple_languages_caption: Grouped by language — each language makes its own deck.
scan_mixed_languages_warning: Pick words from one language at a time. A deck holds a single language.
scan_target_language_body: What language would you like these words translated into?
scan_deck_save_error: Couldn't save your deck. Please try again.
scan_destination_subtitle: Start a new deck, or add them to one you already have.
scan_destination_new_deck_hint: Pick a language and create a fresh deck
scan_select_more_subtitle: Pick the next batch for another deck, or close when you're done.
permission_camera_body: LexiSnap needs your camera to scan text from books, menus, signs, and more.
permission_gallery_body: Choose a photo from your library and LexiSnap will pull the text out of it.
permission_camera_denied_body: Camera access is off for LexiSnap. Enable it in Settings to scan with your camera.
permission_gallery_denied_body: Photo access is off for LexiSnap. Enable it in Settings to choose photos.
deck_load_error: Couldn't load this deck. Please try again.
deck_rename_error: Couldn't rename this deck. Please try again.
deck_delete_body: This deck and all of its flashcards will be deleted. This can't be undone.

card_edit_description_hint: An optional note about this word
card_edit_save_error: Couldn't save the card. Please try again.

cards_copy_error: Couldn't copy the cards. Please try again.
cards_delete_body: These cards will be removed from this deck. This can't be undone.

cards_new_deck_hint: Create a fresh deck for these cards
cards_all_present: Those words are all already in {name}
deck_merge_subtitle: All cards move into the deck you pick, and this deck is deleted.
deck_merge_confirm_body: All {count} cards move into {name}, and this deck is deleted. This can't be undone.
deck_merge_error: Couldn't merge the decks. Please try again.
study_nothing_due_body: Nothing is due, so these are extra practice - your schedule won't change.
study_leave_body: You have {count} cards left. The ones you've already answered still count.
study_leave_body_one: You have 1 card left. The ones you've already answered still count.
study_swipe_hint: Swipe the card, or tap below
streak_freeze_saved_one: A freeze saved your streak yesterday
streak_freeze_next_one: 1 more day to earn a freeze
streak_freeze_next: {count} more days to earn a freeze
streak_info_freezes_full: Freezes full — you're covered for {count} missed days
streak_rule_daily_body: Complete at least one card — you don't need to hit your daily goal. Practice rounds count; listening doesn't.
streak_rule_day_ends_body: A late-night session still counts for the day it started.
streak_rule_earn_body: Every {days} days of streak earns one. You can hold up to {max}.
streak_rule_cover_body: One is used automatically for each day you miss. Frozen days keep your streak alive but don't add to it.
streak_rule_reset_title: Miss too many and it restarts
streak_rule_reset_body: If you miss more days than you have freezes, your streak starts over. Your freezes are kept.
listen_hint: Plays through the deck hands-free. Nothing is graded here.
reminder_notification_body: A few cards are waiting. Two minutes is enough.
reminder_channel_description: Your daily nudge to review flashcards.
reminder_permission_denied: Notifications are off for LexiSnap. Enable them in Settings to get reminders.
reminder_test_body: If you can see this, notifications are working.
study_mode_smart_hint: A random mix of quiz and flip
scan_limit_reached: You've reached today's scan limit — showing basic word detection instead.
translate_limit_reached: You've reached today's translation limit. Try again tomorrow.
subscription_subtitle: Scan more, learn faster. Cancel anytime.
subscription_footnote: Prices in EUR, billed monthly. Subscriptions are coming soon — you'll be able to upgrade right here.
plan_free_tagline: Everything you need to start learning.
plan_plus_tagline: For daily learners who scan a lot.
plan_pro_tagline: Power through whole books and courses.
plan_coming_soon_body: We're putting the finishing touches on billing. You'll be able to upgrade to {name} right here very soon — thanks for your patience!
